''See also: [[Swarm-Queen Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Esh’kinaar]], known as the Swarm-[[Queen]], is a massive entity of the [[D’Niss]] species. Described as being the size of a planet, she possesses immense power, including the ability to consume stars by feeding on their coronas. Her physical form features a carapace, rainbow-colored wings, and four bladed arms. She is regarded by the [[D’Niss]] as a deity, an idol, and their ruler, with all members of her species existing to serve her. In combat, she utilizes mental attacks to weaken opponents and can discharge millions of rainbow-colored orbs. Although the [[Titan Knights]] previously managed the [[D’Niss]], [[Esh’kinaar]]'s return to the dimension poses a galactic threat. Upon her defeat, she was capable of producing a successor, giving birth to a new Swarm-[[Queen]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Swarm-[[Queen]] possesses rainbow wings and four bladed arms. Upon being cleaved, her remaining half collapsed into a shining white ball.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|This entity is capable of restricting magic within a ship and can spray millions of rainbow-colored orbs into space.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Encounter in Visiria}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Aelora]] and [[Javik Leed]] once faced the Swarm-[[Queen]], a being feared by the crew of [[The Last Horizon]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c12">''The Knight'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c33">''The Knight'', chapter 33</ref> The strong [[Aether]] within the [[Visiria system]] was capable of summoning this entity, which possesses power exceeding that of [[Felrex]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c37">''The Knight'', chapter 37</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c38">''The Knight'', chapter 38</ref> This threat can be released upon the galaxy through a [[ritual]] and has the ability to restrict magic aboard a ship.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c39">''The Knight'', chapter 39</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c41">''The Knight'', chapter 41</ref> The creature is characterized by four bladed arms and rainbow wings, which are mirrored in smaller versions on its [[locust soldiers]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c42">''The Knight'', chapter 42</ref> Before its death, the Swarm-[[Queen]] sprayed millions of rainbow-colored orbs into space while focusing on a chant.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c43">''The Knight'', chapter 43</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Birth of the Clone}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Esh’kinaar]] gave birth to a new Swarm-[[Queen]], a black [[D’Niss]] clone featuring four bladed arms and wings of Shadow{{!}}shadow.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c44">''The Knight'', chapter 44</ref> The newborn alien possesses a head resembling an insectoid [[portal]] into a dimension of darkness.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c44" /> After an emerald salvo of shots impacted its carapace, the Swarm-[[Queen]] was cleaved and burned by Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion's attack.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c44" /> The remaining half of the creature subsequently collapsed into a shining white ball.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c44" />}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The new [[Swarm-Queen]] is a black [[D’Niss]] clone of [[Esh’kinaar]] with four bladed arms and wings of Shadow{{!}}shadow.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c44" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The new [[Swarm-Queen]]'s head is like an insectoid [[portal]] onto a dimension of darkness.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c44" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The [[Swarm-Queen]] is a newborn alien with an emerald salvo of shots impacting its carapace.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c44" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The [[Swarm-Queen]] was cleaved and burned by Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion's attack.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c44" />}}</li>

{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Zenith Blade{{!}}The Zenith Blade possessed the ability to shred shields at a rate exceeding that of the Swarm-[[Queen]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c14">''The Pilot'', chapter 14</ref> As a being, the Swarm-[[Queen]] can be defeated in order to overcome the [[spirit]] of an entire world.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c48">''The Pilot'', chapter 48</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Swarm-Queen{{!}}Swarm Queen is a being that can be defeated to beat the [[spirit]] of a single world.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c48" />}}</li>
